mapper.select: SELECT r.sku_id, r.spec_group_id, r.spec_value_id, r.spec_value, r.sort, r.create_time, g.name AS group_name FROM product_sku_spec_rel r JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = r.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spec_group g ON g.id = r.spec_group_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.sku_id ASC, r.sort ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO product_sku_spec_rel (sku_id, spec_group_id, spec_value_id, spec_value, sort, create_time) VALUES
(#{i.skuId}, #{i.specGroupId}, #{i.specValueId}, #{i.specValue}, #{i.sort}, #{i.createTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE spec_value_id = VALUES(spec_value_id), spec_value = VALUES(spec_value), sort = VALUES(sort)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM product_spec_group WHERE name = #{groupName} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM product_spec_value WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND value = #{value} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_spec_value (group_id, value, sort, create_time) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{value}, #{sort}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(sort, 999) FROM product_spec_group WHERE id = #{groupId}
